### [1] [PragyaDoc: A Universal Document Intelligence Framework for Multilingual Medical Document Understanding in Low-Resource Settings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07478)
*Jagpal Singh Jhala*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出PragyaDoc，一个面向印度多语言医疗文档智能处理的通用框架，通过四层流水线（并行集成OCR、几何-词法融合、确定性领域结构化、双LLM医学推理与本地化）解决英语医疗文档与印度22种官方语言患者之间的可访问性障碍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 印度22种官方语言导致严重可访问性壁垒：大多数医疗文档仅以英文编写，而最需要这些信息的农村人群、ASHA工作者和患者家属却无法理解英文内容，形成了功能性的信息排除。

Method: 提出四层流水线架构：(1) 并行集成OCR提取层；(2) 几何-词法融合层；(3) 确定性领域结构化层；(4) 双LLM医学推理与本地化层。

Result: 摘要中未明确给出具体实验结果或量化评估指标。

Conclusion: PragyaDoc作为通用文档智能框架，旨在通过多层技术架构弥合英语医疗文档与印度多语言用户之间的语言鸿沟，使关键医疗信息对农村患者、ASHA工作者及患者家属可及。

Abstract: India's 22 official languages create a critical accessibility barrier: the majority of medical documentation exists exclusively in English, yet the patients who most urgently require this information - rural populations, ASHA workers, and patient families - are functionally excluded from understanding it. This paper presents PragyaDoc, a Universal Document Intelligence Framework that addresses this gap through a four-layer pipeline: a parallel ensemble OCR extraction layer, a geometric-lexical fusion layer, a deterministic domain structuring layer, and a dual-LLM medical reasoning and localization layer

</details>


### [2] [NeuroPilot: An Agent-Driven Smart Pipeline for Processing, Quality Control, and Managing Neuroimages](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07541)
*Yiyao Chen,Yucheng Li,Jungong Tong,Shaoqi Wang,Kunhao Zhou,Ziquan Wei,Monica Murea,Marissa DiPiero,Tingting Dan,Guorong Wu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: NeuroPilot是一个多智能体系统，将神经影像处理、质量控制和数据管理的专业知识数字化为三个LLM可调用的技能（dcm2bids-skill、neuroimage-pre-skill、qc-agent-skill），通过LLM驱动的智能体自主编排工作流，实现跨多种基础设施和队列的自动化神经影像处理。该系统已在17个队列（超过123,000名受试者）上部署验证，覆盖从婴儿到衰老人群及多种MRI模态，可将传统2-3个月的处理培训与处理时间压缩至一周。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 原始神经影像档案转化为可用于分析的衍生数据依赖三个脆弱的阶段：数据标准化、模态特异性预处理和质量控制。虽然单个神经影像工具已发展成熟，但它们的协调编排需要项目特定脚本、环境适应性调优和大量人工QC，缺乏一个能够自动化编排整个流程的统一系统。

Method: NeuroPilot采用多智能体架构，将神经影像处理、QC和数据管理的专业知识数字化为三个LLM可调用的技能：(1) dcm2bids-skill负责数据标准化；(2) neuroimage-pre-skill根据可用模态和队列特征（如婴儿队列）动态选择最优预处理流程（如fMRIPrep或专门管线）；(3) qc-agent-skill通过3D浏览器仪表盘驱动基于证据的半自动化QC，利用多层级验证系统优化失败案例并升级复杂问题供主管检查。LLM驱动的中枢智能体将各种基础设施设置泛化为单一配置，实现最大化可扩展性。

Result: 系统在17个队列（>123,000名受试者）上完成部署，覆盖婴儿到老年人群及结构、弥散、功能等多种MRI模态。QC智能体筛选了558名生产受试者，其自动标记与FreeSurfer拓扑缺陷指标验证一致。婴儿处理管线在QC验证的输入上实现了100%（201/201）的完成率。NeuroPilot将传统的2-3个月培训和处理周期压缩至单周。

Conclusion: NeuroPilot验证了LLM驱动的多智能体系统能够有效替代人工编排神经影像处理流程，通过统一的配置接口和动态管线选择机制，在保证处理质量（100%完成率、QC验证一致）的同时大幅提升效率（从数月压缩至一周），展示了该范式在大规模多队列神经影像处理中的可扩展性和通用性。

Abstract: Transforming raw neuroimage archives into analysis-ready derivatives relies on three brittle stages: data standardization, modality-specific preprocessing, and quality control (QC). While individual neuroimaging tools are well developed, their orchestration requires project-specific scripts, environment-adaptive tuning, and labor-intensive manual QC. To address this, we introduce NeuroPilot, a multi-agent system that digitalizes the expertise of neuroimage processing, QC, and data management into three LLM-invocable skills: dcm2bids-skill, neuroimage-pre-skill, and qc-agent-skill. The LLM-driven agent autonomously orchestrates workflows, generalizing various infrastructure settings into a single configuration to achieve the highest scalability. Demonstrating the system's generalizability, we deployed NeuroPilot across 17 cohorts (>123,000 subjects) spanning infant to aging populations and multiple MRI modalities (structural, diffusion, functional). In practice, after standardizing data via the dcm2bids-skill, the agent dynamically routes datasets to the optimal neuroimage-pre-skill based on available modalities and cohort traits (e.g., dispatching T1w and fMRI data to fMRIPrep, or selecting specialized pipelines for infant cohorts). The qc-agent-skill then drives an evidence-based, semi-automated QC via a 3-D browser dashboard, utilizing a multi-tiered verification system to optimize failed cases and escalate complex issues for supervisor inspection. Quantitatively, our QC agent screened 558 production subjects, validating its automated flags against FreeSurfer's topology-defect metrics. The infant processing pipeline achieved a 100% (201/201) completion rate on QC-validated inputs. Importantly, NeuroPilot compresses the traditional 2--3 month timeline for training staff and processing complete datasets into a single week. NeuroPilot is deployed in https://wanda-cyberbench.com/.

</details>


### [3] [Performance of large language models in the optical diagnosis of colorectal polyps](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07543)
*Joshua C. Vences,William T. Tran,Nikko Gimpaya,Catharine M. Walsh,Rishad J. Khan,Robert Bechara,Asher C. Wiggins,Celine N. Rousan,Kaitlyn V. G. L. Morgado,Angie Ibrahim,Kevin H. M. Kuo,Daniel von Renteln,Alexander Hann,Dennis L. Shung,Michael A. Scaffidi,Charles Ménard,Joshua Landy,Samir C. Grover*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该研究使用PRIME数据集（包含白光与窄带成像图像）评估了5种多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在结直肠息肉分类和病理预测中的诊断准确性。结果显示所有模型在区分肿瘤性与非肿瘤性息肉上F1得分均>0.9，其中Gemini 2.5 Pro在浸润性与非浸润性息肉、低级别与高级别腺瘤区分上表现最佳，而Claude Opus 4和GPT-5在巴黎分型上的正确率最高（41.7%）。但所有模型的敏感性和特异性均未达到ESGE临床标准，提示需开展前瞻性多中心试验并设计人机协作流程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 结直肠息肉的准确光学诊断对于指导息肉切除策略和后续随访至关重要。多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在基于图像的医学诊断中展现了潜力，但尚缺乏对其在结直肠息肉分类与病理学预测方面诊断准确性的系统评估。本研究旨在填补这一空白，评估不同MLLMs在该临床任务上的表现。

Method: 回顾性诊断性能研究。使用PRIME数据集（包含白光和窄带成像图像），对132个病例进行评估。纳入5种MLLM模型（Claude Opus 4、Gemini 2.5 Pro、GPT-o3、GPT-4o、GPT-5），针对巴黎分型、NICE分型和病理预测，计算F1分数、正确率百分比和准确度，并与专家应答进行比较。采用Cochran's Q检验和McNemar检验确定各模型预测值之间的差异。

Result: 所有MLLM在肿瘤性vs.非肿瘤性息肉分类上的F1得分均>0.9。Gemini 2.5 Pro在浸润性vs.非浸润性息肉（F1=0.560）和低级别vs.高级别腺瘤（F1=0.492）上获得最高F1得分。在巴黎分型正确率方面，Claude Opus 4和GPT-5显著高于其他模型（均为41.7%）。然而，所有模型的敏感性和特异性均未达到ESGE设定的临床标准。

Conclusion: Claude Opus 4和Gemini 2.5 Pro在区分息肉亚型方面展现出最高准确度，最接近专家共识水平。但鉴于敏感性和特异性不达标，在临床部署前仍需开展前瞻性多中心试验，并设计人机协作（human-in-the-loop）工作流程。

Abstract: Background and Study Aims: Accurate optical diagnosis of colorectal polyps guides resection strategy and surveillance, with multimodal large language models (MLLMs) showing potential for image-based diagnosis. We aimed to evaluate the diagnostic accuracy of MLLMs in classifying colorectal polyps and predicting histology. Methods: We conducted a retrospective diagnostic performance study using the PRIME dataset, a curated set of white light and narrow-band imaging (NBI) images. We evaluated Claude Opus 4, Google Gemini 2.5 Pro, GPT-o3, GPT-4o, and GPT-5. For Paris, Narrow-band Imaging Colorectal Endoscopic (NICE), and predicted histology, we calculated F1 scores, percent correct scores, and accuracy of each MLLM compared to expert responses for 132 cases. Cochran's Q and McNemar's Test were used to determine differences between predicted values of each MLLM. Results: The F1 scores among MLLMs were >0.9 for all models for neoplastic vs. non-neoplastic polyps. Gemini 2.5 Pro demonstrated the highest F1 scores for invasive vs. non-invasive polyps and low- vs. high-grade adenoma, at 0.560 and 0.492 respectively. Claude Opus 4 and GPT-5 had statistically significantly higher percent correct scores than other MLLMs at 41.7%, using Paris classification. Conclusions: Claude Opus 4 and Gemini 2.5 Pro showed the highest accuracy in differentiating polyp subtypes, performing closest to expert consensus. Sensitivity and specificity, however, did not meet ESGE standards, highlighting the need for prospective multicenter trials and the design of human-in-the-loop workflows before clinical deployment.

</details>


### [4] [Learning an Interior Layout Policy in a Domain Specific Language Action Space](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07547)
*Yuhao Lu,Weichen Zhang,Wenyi Xiao,Haohui Chen,Yiyun Fei*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出LayoutDSL，一种基于大语言模型（LLM）的室内场景布局生成框架，通过领域特定语言（DSL）动作空间学习布局策略，并利用基于室内设计原则和物理合理性的奖励进行强化学习优化，显著提升了布局的空间合理性和设计逻辑性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有室内场景布局生成方法存在两个核心问题：一是将房间条件简化为粗略的3D边界框，忽略了门窗等结构元素；二是将空间推理建模为连续坐标回归，阻碍模型学习布局设计的底层推理逻辑。因此需要一种能够显式表达布局信息并提供可解释设计动作的框架。

Method: 提出LayoutDSL框架：（1）设计一种领域特定语言（DSL），提供布局信息的显式符号表示，并作为布局推理的结构化动作空间，每个动作对应一个可解释的设计决策；（2）构建3D-FrontDSL数据集，包含房间结构注释和合成的DSL动作序列，用于监督微调；（3）基于室内设计原则和物理合理性设计奖励函数，通过强化学习优化策略，使策略更具泛化性和可扩展性。

Result: 大量实验表明，LayoutDSL在空间合理性和设计逻辑性方面相较于强基线方法和现有方法均有显著提升。

Conclusion: 将布局生成建模为DSL动作空间中的策略学习，结合强化学习与可验证的反馈信号，是提升室内布局生成质量的有效范式，为后续研究提供了可解释、可泛化的新方向。

Abstract: Indoor scene layout generation is a challenging task in interior design. Existing methods often oversimplify the task by reducing room conditions to coarse 3D bounding boxes and neglecting structural elements such as doors and windows. More fundamentally, many prior approaches formulate spatial reasoning as direct coordinate prediction, thereby casting interior layout design as continuous regression over raw geometric parameters, which hinders the model from learning the underlying reasoning logic of intelligent layout design. We propose \textbf{LayoutDSL}, a novel LLM-based framework for learning an interior layout policy in a domain-specific language (DSL) action space. The DSL provides an explicit symbolic representation of layout information and serves as a structured action space for layout reasoning, where each action corresponds to an interpretable design decision. Under this DSL-based policy learning paradigm, we construct 3D-FrontDSL, a dataset of room-structure annotations paired with synthetic DSL action sequences for supervised fine-tuning. To promote a more generalizable and scalable policy with verifiable feedback, we design rewards grounded in interior design principles and physical plausibility, and optimize the policy via reinforcement learning. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LayoutDSL substantially improves spatial plausibility and design logicality over strong baselines and existing methods.

</details>


### [5] [P2Voxel: Pyramid Pivot Voxelization for 3D Mesh Tokenization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07549)
*Zhenhong Sun,Haozhe Liu,Yifu Wang,Xibin Song,Senbo Wang,Huadong Mo,Daoyi Dong,Hongdong Li,Pan Ji*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出P2Voxel，一种基于金字塔枢轴体素化的网格tokenization框架，通过局部表面证据采样将不规则网格转化为紧凑、结构化且可学习的金字塔枢轴token，实现高效的网格重建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 三角网格提供精确的表面几何信息，但其不规则的拓扑连接使得网格tokenization成为一个几何采样问题：如何将几何证据紧凑、结构化且可学习地组织为token。现有的基于场中心体素采样和边相交曲面采样的方法未能捕捉足够的局部几何证据。

Method: P2Voxel框架包含三个核心创新：(1) 在局部平坦性假设下，枢轴体素化用表面枢轴和方向符号表示每个活动体素，提供最小局部证据以诱导确定性重建所需的角点值；(2) 在空间复杂度假设下，金字塔枢轴体素化利用曲面的空间不均匀性，对几何复杂区域分配更细的枢轴token，光滑区域保持粗粒度；(3) 在块可重建性假设下，金字塔VAE学习紧凑的多分辨率潜在编码，避免对整个高分辨率体素化形状建模为密集全局场。

Result: P2Voxel将网格转换为紧凑、结构化且可学习的金字塔枢轴token，实现了高效的下游3D任务网格重建。

Conclusion: 通过局部表面证据采样策略和金字塔多分辨率设计，P2Voxel为网格tokenization提供了一种重建感知的紧凑表示方案，能够高效支持下游3D任务。

Abstract: Triangle meshes provide explicit and accurate surface geometry, yet their irregular topology connectivity makes 3D mesh tokenization a geometric sampling problem: how to sample and organize geometric evidence into compact, structured and learnable tokens. Beyond field-centric volumetric sampling and edge-intersection surface sampling, we retarget mesh tokenization as \textit{local surface evidence sampling}: identifying the minimal geometric evidence inside each active voxel that is sufficient for deterministic surface recovery. To this end, we introduce \textbf{P2Voxel}, a pyramid pivot voxelization framework for compact and reconstruction-aware mesh tokenization. P2Voxel is built on three key innovations. Under the \textit{Local Planarity} assumption, Pivot Voxelization represents each active voxel with a surface pivot and an orientation sign, providing minimal local evidence that can induce the corner values required for deterministic reconstruction. Under the \textit{Spatial Complexity} assumption, Pyramid Pivot Voxelization exploits the spatial non-uniformity of real surfaces by allocating finer pivot tokens to geometrically complex regions while keeping smooth regions coarse and compact. Under the \textit{Block Reconstructability} assumption, a Pyramid VAE learns compact multi-resolution latent codes over locally reconstructable pivot blocks, avoiding the need to model the entire high-resolution voxelized shape as a dense global field. Together, these designs convert meshes into compact, structured, and learnable pyramid pivot tokens, enabling efficient mesh reconstruction for downstream 3D tasks.

</details>


### [6] [Auditing Medical Vision-Language Models on Chest Radiographs: Estimating Reference Agreement Across Institutions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07550)
*Pengyang Yu,Yiou Wang,Zhongping Dong,Sahraoui Dhelim,Chun-Mei Feng,M. Tahar Kechadi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文评估了三个生成式视觉-语言模型在三个机构的胸部X光语料库、六种发现、两种提示协议下超过34.5万条发现级预测，并在小规模本地标注预算下估计接收机构的"发现×方向"参考一致性。研究发现：在完全排除接收机构参与开发时，自适应选择策略并未优于简单固定估计器；两个最优固定估计器（Beta-Binomial经验贝叶斯与目标仅逻辑回归）性能差距小于求解器版本变化带来的敏感性，且各在约半数场景中领先，无法推荐默认方案；跨机构合并估计的优势仅集中在一个站点，按机构聚类后不具确认性；名义95%的后验预测计数区间实际覆盖率仅87.0%。结论是参考一致性必须按站点、按接口重新评估，且结果关乎机构标签一致性而非临床正确性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉-语言模型返回结构化胸部X光发现时未暴露置信度分数，接收机构无法得知对单条判断的信任程度。参考一致性能否跨站点、发现、预测方向及问题格式迁移，迄今缺乏大规模量化测量。

Method: 在三个机构胸部X光语料库上，对三个生成式视觉-语言模型、六种发现、两种提示协议进行评估，产生超过34.5万条发现级预测。利用小规模本地标注预算估计"发现×方向"参考一致性，并设计七种估计器，在反复严格机构留出评估下进行压力测试。

Result: 排除接收机构参与开发时，自适应选择未优于固定备选（均Brier 0.1083 vs 0.0853和0.0855）。两个最优固定估计器差距仅0.0003，小于该家族对求解器版本变化的敏感性，且各在约半数场景领先。其相对合并估计器的优势集中在一个站点，按机构聚类不显著；名义95%覆盖率实际只有87.0%，在最难机构更低。

Conclusion: 参考一致性必须逐站点、逐接口重新评估，不存在可推广的默认估计器；研究结果反映的是与机构标签的一致性，而非临床正确性。

Abstract: Vision-language models return structured chest-radiograph findings through interfaces exposing no confidence score, so a receiving institution cannot read off how far to trust an individual judgment. Whether agreement with an institution's reference standard transfers across sites, findings, prediction directions and question formats is largely unmeasured. We evaluated three generative vision-language models on three institutional chest-radiograph corpora and six findings under two elicitation protocols, comprising more than 345,000 finding-level predictions, and estimated finding-by-direction reference agreement at a receiving institution from a small budget of local labels. Estimation strategies were then stress-tested under repeated strict institution-held-out evaluation. Under evaluation excluding the receiving institution from development entirely, adaptive selection among the seven estimators that design admits did not improve on simple fixed alternatives: it achieved a mean Brier score of 0.1083, against 0.0853 for always using a Beta-Binomial empirical-Bayes estimator and 0.0855 for a target-only logistic model. Those two differ by 0.0003, less than this family's own sensitivity to a change of solver version, and each leads in about half the settings, so no default can be recommended. Their advantage over estimators pooling across institutions was concentrated at one site and not confirmatory once clustered by institution, and a plug-in empirical-Bayes posterior-predictive count interval at a nominal 95% level covered 87.0%, less at the hardest institution. Reference agreement therefore has to be re-evaluated per site and per interface; these results concern agreement with institutional labels, not clinical correctness.

</details>


### [7] [Impact of Dataset Composition on Embedded Real-Time UAV Wildfire Detection Using Compact YOLO Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07554)
*Eduardo de los Santos,Andre S. Kelbouscas,Ricardo B. Grando,Bruna V. Guterres*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本研究探讨了数据集构成对嵌入式实时无人机野火检测性能的影响，使用紧凑型YOLO模型作为受控验证基线。实验对比了四种训练配置（真实非增强、真实增强、混合非增强、混合增强），其中混合集合并了真实野火图像与AI生成样本。结果表明，真实非增强数据集取得了最佳的整体部署性能，在召回率与平均精度均值之间达到最优平衡，且合成数据混合与数据增强均未产生更好的最终部署选择。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无人机视觉野火检测系统的发展受限于真实世界训练图像的多样性不足，研究旨在系统性地评估数据集构成（包括合成数据混合与图像增强）对资源受限条件下嵌入式实时检测性能的实际影响，以指导数据集构建策略。

Method: 以紧凑型YOLO模型作为受控验证模型族，设计了四种训练配置：真实非增强、真实增强、混合非增强和混合增强。其中混合数据集将真实野火图像与AI生成的合成样本相结合，在嵌入式实时部署条件下对比各配置的检测性能。

These relationships are learned through cross- and self-attention mechanisms. MVMD consists of three key blocks: the Inter-Views Block tracks the shifts of objects within mirrors caused by changes in viewpoint; the Intra-View Block detects object reflections inside mirrors; and the Refinement Block sharpens mirror boundaries and enhances detected details.

Explainable artificial intelligence techniques, including LIME, LRP, Attention-Min, and Attention-Max, were used to improve model transparency and clinical trust. Abstract: Conversational assistants increasingly recommend follow-up edits to help users continue a task. Existing systems primarily target text-only interactions, leaving image-creation conversations underexplored. In image-creation tasks, useful follow-up edit suggestions must reflect user preferences, offer diverse directions, and remain executable on the current image. We collected 100,000 real multi-turn image-creation conversation samples from Qwen App and found that 80.1% are image-dependent, underscoring the need for multimodal recommendation. We address this setting with a three-stage framework. In Stage 1, we use real online data to build a human-reviewed table of appropriate follow-up editing intents, then create SFT targets and fine-tune a multimodal policy. In Stage 2, to align rule-guided SFT suggestions with actual user choices, we use user click feedback to optimize the policy through multi-objective reinforcement learning. In Stage 3, to reduce visual inconsistencies between suggested edits and the current image, we introduce a visual verifier as additional training supervision. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our framework significantly outperforms baselines on both automatic and human evaluations. In a live user-randomized A/B test with millions of users, our final framework reduces visual inconsistency from 3.7% to 0.9%. Furthermore, it significantly improves recommendation CTR by 32.70%, image take-away rate by 16.32%, and average conversation turns per user by 39.90% (all p<0.05).

  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有fNIRS ASD分类方法假设时间对齐评估，但实际中由于个体间血流动力学延迟和神经血管耦合差异，最优观测窗口因人而异，造成时间分布偏移并严重降低模型性能。这一现实问题尚未被系统研究。

Abstract: Functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) is a promising modality for autism spectrum disorder (ASD) classification, yet existing approaches assume temporally aligned evaluation. We formalize this as a \textit{cross-time-window transfer problem}, introducing a protocol that varies window length (2.5--10\,s) and offset within biological motion trials. Using topographic map representations of fNIRS recordings, we benchmark three vision architectures under two zero-shot baselines and eight adaptation strategies under leave-one-subject-out cross-validation ($N{=}124$). Result: 在544个VAE-编辑单元中，LFV发射423个低成本算子：277个由C1处理，146个(34.5%)需要通道混合。在120单元径向扫描中99/100发射算子通过源视频分组留出评估，另外五个滤波家族的323个发射算子全部通过。完全冻结的OpenVid拟合算子（包括验证选择的路径系数）在20个CogVideoX和HunyuanVideo生成域单元上全部通过且无需适应。所选响应与直接潜在滤波延迟相当，比像素滤波-再编码快约3倍。

Conclusion: LFV揭示了不同的VAE机制：CogVideoX表现为强通道耦合响应，Open-Sora存在尖锐高带宽稳定性边界。该方法证明了跨通道容量作为可控资源的技术可行性，在保持编辑质量的同时显著提升效率。

Abstract: Explainable aesthetic image cropping requires not only localizing a visually pleasing crop but also explaining why it is preferred. Abstract: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have demonstrated exceptional performance in high-fidelity image and video generation. To alleviate their massive computational overhead, temporal feature caching has been proposed to bypass redundant computations. However, existing cache-then-forecast methods driven by derivative-based polynomials often cause severe quality degradation under high acceleration due to unstable long-step predictions. To address this bottleneck, we propose Barycentric Rational Forecasting with Chebyshev Enhancement (BRACE). Motivated by the observation that DiT feature trajectories are globally smooth yet frequently exhibit sharp irregularities and local non-smoothness, BRACE shifts the paradigm from derivative-driven polynomial extrapolation to feature-driven rational forecasting. </details>

We adapt both a convolutional (3D U-Net) and a transformer (SwinUNETR) backbone, aggregate overlapping patches by Gaussian consensus, and compute point-spread-function-corrected membrane thickness by ray-surface intersection on the GPU.

We quantify GBM thickness across the reconstructed 3D surface and capture disease-related thickening, enabling fully automated anisotropic 3D morphometry of biological structures without dense volumetric labels or image restoration.

  <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: A closed-set detector for autonomous driving must assign every object one of a fixed set of labels. On an object outside that set (a horse-drawn carriage, road debris, livestock on a rural road) it can only force a confident but wrong specific label or drop the object. Prior work in this series replaced the flat label set with a hierarchical taxonomy and a runtime abstraction rule, but evaluated it only on the boxes a closed detector already produces. This paper takes the layer open-world: we place taxonomic abstraction on top of class-agnostic region proposals so objects the closed detector never boxes can still be classified or flagged; we report a feasibility study of three open-world signals (class-agnostic segmentation, appearance-based out-of-distribution scoring, monocular depth) that shows why no single 2D cue suffices and how they compose; and we run the evaluation the earlier papers could not, a ground-truth leave-classes-out benchmark on real annotated objects. Holding out seven COCO classes and classifying their 235 ground-truth crops, a flat closed head emits a confident wrong specific label 100% of the time (37% of them in the wrong super-category, e.g. an animal named as a vehicle), whereas the hierarchical layer emits zero confident wrong specific labels and safely handles 94% of the objects (a correct super-category, or an explicit UNKNOWN OBSTACLE). We are explicit that this is a safety result, not a specificity one: the correct super-category is recovered only 26% of the time and the remaining 69% are conservatively flagged unknown. The contribution is an open-world perception layer that never makes a confident categorical mistake on an out-of-vocabulary object, together with an honest account of its cost.

</details>

*Abdullah Naeem,Anav Katwal,Ayon Dey,Noman Khan,Md Tamjidul Hoque*

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 验证一个假设：在合成到真实（Sim2Real）的多相机3D感知设置下，决定性能的关键是跨视角几何一致性，而非单目深度估计的精度。同时探索在推理阶段仅使用RGB（深度仅用于训练/验证）的条件下，如何构建最优的多相机3D感知管线。

Result: 几何优先管线达到13.0 3D HOTA（51.6 LocA），伪LiDAR路线崩溃至0.12（9.2 LocA）。失败原因归结为单目深度的跨视角不一致性——尺度校正是必要非充分条件，域适应微调在预算内无法修复。在几何管线中仅离线拼接有效，其余所有消融干预均未超越基线。

Conclusion: 在Sim2Real多相机3D感知中，跨视角几何一致性是决定性因素；检测质量（DetA）约束几何路线上限，定位一致性（LocA）约束伪LiDAR路线。发布完整可复现的RGB-only管线及消融实验。

Abstract: The AI City Challenge 2026 Track 1 evaluates multi-camera 3D perception in large indoor warehouses under a synthetic-to-real (Sim2Real) setting; depth is available only for training and validation, so inference is RGB-only. We use two RGB-only routes as a controlled test of one hypothesis: that cross-view geometric consistency, not monocular depth accuracy, governs performance under Sim2Real. The first is a geometry-first pipeline: YOLO11x detection, homography lifting to the world frame, class-level 3D size priors, multi-camera fusion, world-coordinate tracking, and offline tracklet stitching. The second is estimated-depth pseudo-LiDAR: monocular depth (D4RT, Metric3D~v2) back-projected into a fused point cloud and passed to a 3D detector (V-DETR), mirroring prior point-cloud winners that used depth. The gap is decisive: geometry-first reaches 13.0 3D HOTA (51.6 LocA), whereas pseudo-LiDAR collapses to 0.12 (9.2 LocA). We trace the collapse to cross-view inconsistency of monocular depth---scale correction is necessary but not sufficient---which domain-adaptation fine-tuning does not repair within budget. Within the geometry pipeline, offline stitching is the only intervention that helps; SAHI detection, appearance Re-ID, learned lifting, RT-DETR ensembling, test-time augmentation, and domain randomization all fail to beat the baseline detector. The bottlenecks are complementary: detection quality bounds the geometry route (DetA), localization consistency bounds pseudo-LiDAR (LocA). We release a complete, reproducible RGB-only pipeline and ablation.

</details>

  <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: Long-video understanding requires models to efficiently acquire and reuse sparse visual evidence from long and redundant video streams. Recent video tool-use agents address this challenge by iteratively invoking visual Tools at different temporal scales, but their Tool-Planner communication typically relies on textual observations. During planning, LAVE retrieves evidence relevant to the current Planner state but not covered by textual observations, and integrates it through bounded timestamp-aligned latent updates with entropy-constrained frame-time routing. </details>

  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: SSCIL在无范例设定下是最具挑战性的场景，因为无法存储过去数据。现有方法因特征漂移而灾难性遗忘，且随标签空间增长伪标签可靠性急剧下降。需要一种无需存储范例即可稳定表征空间的方法。

Conclusion: MAGIC通过几何校准与结构对齐的双重约束，在不存储任何范例的前提下有效缓解特征漂移，保持了类别间几何关系的稳定性，尤其擅长低标签率、细粒度分类场景。

Abstract: Semi-supervised Class Incremental Learning (SSCIL) is a severe challenge for neural networks, and it is hardest in the exemplar-free setting where no past data may be stored. Existing methods forget catastrophically due to feature drift, and their pseudo-labels become increasingly unreliable as the label space grows. In this paper, we propose MAGIC (Manifold Anchoring and Geometric Incremental Calibration), a framework that stabilizes plasticity without storing exemplars. MAGIC's design centers on two components. The first is Soft-Weighted Geometry Calibration (SWGC), which uses graph-based label propagation on the learner's plastic feature space to weight and calibrate class means and variances computed on the frozen backbone; from these calibrated Gaussians, we sample phantom features that stand in for data from previous tasks. </details>

*Dong Liu,Yanxuan Yu,Renata Borovica-Gajic,Ying Nian Wu*

Abstract: Recent advances in flow matching models have substantially improved the quality of text-to-image generation, but have also raised increasing safety concerns due to their potential to generate harmful or undesirable content. Abstract: Land Surface Temperature (LST) is a widely used satellite-derived measure of urban surface heat, but there is no shared benchmark for forecasting it at 30 m.   <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前交通数据采集依赖深度目标检测器加跟踪-by-检测的流程，这要求检测器已对该类物体完成训练，而在实际部署中这往往是缺失的。作者希望探索一种无需训练、类别无关、适用于极低算力硬件（树莓派）的纯几何交通感知方案。

Abstract: Traffic data collection is dominated today by deep object detectors followed by tracking-by-detection, a pipeline that presupposes what is often missing in practice: a detector already trained on the class one wants to count. We revisit a purely geometric traffic-sensing pipeline for Single Board Computers in which detection is class-agnostic: moving objects come from background subtraction and thresholding, and counting is decided by a geometric rule on an imaginary line across the road, a software inductive loop detector. With no object model, training set or per-object trajectory, it runs faster than real time on Raspberry Pi class hardware. Two counting rules are described: a constant average speed rule, whose expected accuracy is derived analytically as about 86% under a Gaussian speed distribution, and a self-calibrating pre-calibration rule that recovers the lane geometry from blob statistics and counts edges of lane occupancy, additionally yielding per-vehicle average speed at no extra cost. Over four videos the latter counts with 83.3%-100% accuracy; in a field deployment it reaches 91% against 37.5% for a blob-tracking baseline under the same compute budget. We report the observations of that period in detail: the resolution floor below which accuracy collapses, the frame rate floor at which vehicles alias past the counting line, the gap between short curated clips and long uncontrolled footage, and the trade-off between Python (easier to tune, 100% CPU) and C++ (40% CPU, thermally viable). These are properties of the sampling geometry, not of the hardware of the time, and still constrain edge deployments. We close by arguing where motion-based, class-agnostic detection remains the right tool: open-set classes with no annotated data, tight power budgets, privacy-constrained installations, and the cold start of mining training crops to bootstrap a learned detector.

*Yeeun Choi,Youngbeom Yoo,Joon-Young Lee,Hyolim Kang,Seon Joo Kim*

TL;DR: MERIT提出了一种面向超长视频理解的两阶段框架，通过多键情节检索精确召回细粒度记忆，并在推理时按需进行时间邻域扩展以获取语义上下文，在三个长视频基准上达到最先进水平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当视频从数小时延伸到数天时，当前多模态大语言模型端到端处理变得不可行，需要两阶段范式（查询无关的记忆构建+基于检索的推理）。已有工作投入复杂记忆构建以预先建模视频中的高层关系，但构建时并不知晓下游查询，导致前期建模可能与实际查询不匹配且计算开销巨大。

Method: MERIT采用两个关键设计：1) 情节式多键表示（episodic multi-key representation），通过简单的键匹配机制实现细粒度记忆的精确检索；2) 邻域过滤机制（neighbor filtering），仅在推理时围绕检索到的片段进行时间范围的按需扩展，从而在避免全局记忆构建的巨大计算开销的同时捕获更广泛的语义上下文。

Result: MERIT在三个长视频基准（EgoLifeQA、LVBench和Video-MME Long）上均取得了最先进性能，验证了"优先构建高召回可检索性记忆，将查询特定的高层关系组合推迟到推理阶段"这一设计原则的有效性。

Conclusion: 该工作表明，与其在记忆构建阶段投入大量计算去模拟未知的下游查询关系，不如通过轻量的多键检索配合推理时的按需时间扩展来高效完成任务，为超长视频理解提供了一个简单而有效的代理式框架。

Abstract: When videos extend from hours to days, directly processing them end-to-end becomes impractical for current Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs). This ultra-long setting necessitates a two-stage paradigm: query-agnostic memory construction followed by retrieval-based inference. Prior work invests in complex memory construction to pre-model high-level relations in videos, despite not knowing the downstream query at build time. We instead prioritize high-recall retrievability during memory building, and defer query-specific, high-level relation composition to inference time. To this end, we propose MERIT(Multi-key Episodic Retrieval with Inference-time Temporal expansion), a simple yet effective agentic framework for ultra-long video understanding. First, we formulate an episodic multi-key representation that enables precise retrieval of fine-grained memories through a simple key-matching mechanism. Second, we introduce a neighbor filtering mechanism to capture broader semantic context without the massive computational overhead of global memory construction. This is achieved by expanding the temporal scope exclusively around the retrieved segments at inference time. By leveraging simple key-matching with this on-demand temporal expansion, MERIT achieves state-of-the-art performance across three long-video benchmarks: EgoLifeQA, LVBench, and Video-MME (Long).

</details>

  <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: Generative traffic video forecasting aims to synthesize long-horizon, temporally coherent future videos of traffic scenes from a short observation history and textual descriptions. In this paper, we present CosmosAlign, a generative traffic video forecasting framework built upon the pretrained Cosmos3-Nano world foundation model. Our approach is motivated by the observation that successfully adapting large pretrained world models to downstream forecasting tasks depends primarily on distribution alignment rather than increased model capacity. To this end, we propose a two-stage LoRA adaptation strategy that first aligns the conditioning-mode distribution with the target forecasting task, and then aligns the training captions with the model's native structured prompting interface through an LLM-based re-captioning pipeline. During inference, we further improve prediction quality using a fully training-free procedure consisting of consensus-based medoid sample selection and motion-adaptive blending of static scene regions. CosmosAlign achieves a final score of 76.49 on the AI City Challenge 2026 Track 5 benchmark, ranking first on the final leaderboard. Our code is publicly available at https://quangminhdinh.github.io/CosmosAlign/.

*Ziqiao Yu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出SpikeWorld，一个1.45M参数的稀疏脉冲模型，联合训练异构感官预测、语义、图像-文本绑定和动作条件动力学。部署时所有参数冻结，通过两个外部路径（累积固定库损失选择有界动作修正，路由特定残差矩阵细化下一状态预测）来更新延迟的下一状态残差，不需要标签、教师输出、奖励或真实移位值。联合优化使动作下一状态MSE降低17.10%，在多个基准测试中改善多模态预测和语义精度，并将冻结策略奖励提升7.90分。

  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预测模型在观察到动作后果时会收到自监督信号，但当动力学和语义共享参数时，部署后利用该信号很困难：冻结参数会阻碍适应，而权重更新需要优化器状态且可能改变已学表示。现有方法无法在部署时高效利用自监督信号而不破坏已学习的表示。

Method: SpikeWorld采用稀疏脉冲网络联合训练异构感官预测、语义、图像-文本绑定和动作条件动力学。部署时冻结所有训练参数，通过两条外部路径处理延迟的下一状态残差：(1) 累积固定库（fixed-bank）损失选择有界动作修正；(2) 路由特定残差矩阵精化下一状态预测。两条路径均无需标签、教师输出、奖励、成功信号或真实移位值。

Conclusion: SpikeWorld证明在推理时可以不更新共享参数、也不依赖任何外部监督信号的情况下，仅通过两条外部残差路径即可有效利用自监督信号进行在线适应。其增益来源于冻结多模态脉冲检查点与外部适应机制的集成，而非单纯的线性识别能力，代码已公开。

Abstract: A predictive model receives a self-supervised signal whenever the consequence of an action is observed. Using that signal after deployment is difficult when dynamics and semantics share parameters: freezing prevents adaptation, whereas weight updates require optimizer state and may alter the learned representation. Here we introduce SpikeWorld, a 1.45M-parameter sparse spiking model jointly trained for heterogeneous sensory prediction, semantics, image-text binding and action-conditioned dynamics. At deployment, all trained parameters are frozen. Delayed next-state residuals update two external paths: cumulative fixed-bank losses select the bounded action correction, while route-specific residual matrices refine next-state prediction. Neither path uses labels, teacher outputs, rewards, success signals or the true shift value. Joint optimization improves action next-state MSE by 17.10\% while also improving multimodal prediction, semantic accuracy and image-text retrieval. On held-out shear and attenuation streams, the combined external state improves aggregate prediction by 5.48\% and 30.01\%; its fixed-bank action path improves tracking by 24.20\% and 3.94\%, respectively. In a six-arm study comprising 450 new Meta-World trajectories (75 per arm), SpikeWorld raises frozen-policy reward by 7.90 (95\% CI [2.48, 14.06]); the 13.33-point success difference is descriptive (CI [0, 40]). For identical sensory inputs, model parameters and inherited semantic outputs remain bitwise unchanged. A 16-byte RLS estimator obtains the highest non-oracle reward on linear attenuation, showing that the contribution is not superior linear identification, but its integration with a frozen multimodal spiking checkpoint. Reference code is publicly available at https://github.com/Oooorca/SpikeWorld.

</details>

Abstract: Visual-language models (VLMs) frequently struggle with robustness issues in real-world situations due to low- or varying-quality input images. Besides varying over a wide-range of input perturbations, BRUCE employs two novel metrics -- Robustness Corruption Index (RCI) and Traversal-RCI (T-RCI) -- to quantify how rapidly multimodal reasoning performance deteriorates in VLMs as visual corruption severity increases under progressive perturbation scaling. Abstract: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning enables the adaptation of vision foundation models to biomedical tasks under limited computational resources, but a single low-rank update can constrain all task-specific changes to one narrow parameter subspace. These results suggest that organizing adaptation capacity into distinct global and residual paths can improve the external-domain generalization of parameter-efficiently adapted biomedical vision models.

Abstract: Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) have found successful deployment in numerous vision perception systems.   <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉语言接地研究大多将接地简化为单向定位问题：给定预先指定的文本短语或类别名称，识别对应的图像区域。这种设定假设相关的语言单元已知，忽略了接地通信中更基本的挑战——确定文本的哪些部分具有视觉指称性以及它们如何与图像中的实体对应。作者旨在解决这一被忽视的核心问题，将接地任务推向更接近真实表达场景的设定。

Abstract: Vision-language grounding connects language to visual content, yet most existing formulations reduce grounding to a unidirectional localization problem: given a prespecified text phrase or category name, identify the corresponding image region. We formulate grounding as $\textit{bidirectional concept correspondence}$ over an image-text pair. To address this task, we introduce $\textbf{ConCor-1}$, a grounding model built on top of a pretrained vision-language model. It uses learnable $\textit{bridge tokens}$ to represent candidate image-text correspondences and predicts, for each token, a text mask, an image mask, and a correspondence presence score. To train and evaluate this task, we convert diverse grounding and segmentation datasets into a unified correspondence format. Experiments show that $\textbf{ConCor-1}$ consistently outperforms baselines, improving correspondence F1 by 48% on the long-caption dataset and by 29% on zero-shot LVIS, where the large category list serves as the text input.

  <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: Industrial anomaly inspection is severely hindered by the scarcity of real anomalous data.Zero-shot industrial anomaly generation addresses this by generating anomalies on specific products without requiring any of their real anomalous images. However, existing methods suffer from two critical limitations, i.e., inaccurate anomaly information acquisition and uncontrolled anomaly-product fusion.To overcome these challenges, we propose DeCo, which decouples the anomaly structure from its source product, and explicitly recouples it with the normal textures of the target product. During anomaly information acquisition,Dual-Routing Flow (DR-Flow) binds the texture-invariant anomaly structure to an abnormal token, while a parallel constraint, Product-Invariant Flow (PI-Flow), prevents the abnormal token from binding the source product. During anomaly-product fusion, we propose a hybrid injection to recouple the acquired anomaly structure with the target product, and Product Compatibility Correction (PCC) to compensate for the incompatibility between the acquired anomaly structure and the product.   <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: Image demosaicing reconstructs a full-color image from incomplete color measurements produced by a sensor covered with a color filter array (CFA). Extensive experiments on synthetic, external, and challenging datasets demonstrate consistent improvements across different architectures and CFA layouts.

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态LLM裁判面板通过交叉引用同行判断来提升评估可靠性，但被引用的同行判断本身可能不可信。现有研究未充分暴露这一文本层面的攻击面，即源盲锚定效应——模型在未核实引用来源真实性的情况下被锚定于引用内容。

Abstract: Multimodal LLM judge panels can cross-reference peers, but a quoted peer judgment may itself be untrusted. A matched-content, label-only control changes the broken rate by only $-0.17$pp (95\% CI $[-0.68,0.35]$), showing that the self/peer label itself does not explain the effect. Under our tested construction, deliberately generated, concise wrong quotes overturn originally-correct verdicts 1.5--2.7$\times$ more often than naturally occurring wrong peer statements, with bootstrap 95\% CIs excluding parity across two datasets and seven VLM judges. Because the two statement populations differ in selection and form, this ratio measures differential damage under the tested attack rather than a provenance-only causal effect. We then introduce panel-consensus verification, which cross-checks a quote against independently collected blind votes. It blocks 84.9\% of fabricated attacks, cuts their net harm by 97.5\%, and preserves the positive but statistically inconclusive point estimate for genuine peer information under leave-one-out re-verification. These results identify a low-cost attack surface and a concrete defense for safer multimodal collaborative evaluation.

</details>


### [54] [SCoPE: Training-Free Audio-Visual Event Perception via Sparse Cross-Modal Prior Exchange](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07923)
*Jaemo Jeong,Junho Yoon,Hyunju Kim,Dongman Lee*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SCoPE是一个无需训练的音频-视觉事件感知框架，通过让所有查询标签竞争共享证据、模态间相互引导事件选择，解决了错误标签虚假共激活（FCA）问题，在多个基准上显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有训练无关的AVEP方法通过匹配冻结的音频/视觉特征与文本编码事件名来查询新事件词汇，但相关标签共享证据，导致错误标签也能获得与正确标签相当甚至更高的分数（称为FCA）。单一标量阈值无法在拒绝错误标签的同时保留所有正确标签，类特定阈值虽可抑制错误标签成为最终预测，但FCA仍残留在底层得分向量中，影响下游任务。

Method: SCoPE提出一种训练无关框架，核心思想是：（1）所有查询标签相互竞争共享证据，而非独立评分；（2）每个模态（音频、视觉）引导另一个模态进行事件选择。作者推导出在两标签拟合下竞争机制能够消除FCA的精确条件，并采用冻结的CLIP+CLAP骨干网络实现。

Result: 在LLP数据集上，与报告AV²A值相比，Type@seg提升7.45个点，Event@seg提升5.04个点。相同的固定配置无需调整即可迁移到OV-AVEBench和VGGSound-AVEL100k数据集。

Conclusion: 通过标签间竞争共享证据和跨模态相互引导，SCoPE在训练无关的设定下有效消除FCA，且具有良好的泛化能力，可直接迁移至多个基准数据集。

Abstract: Audio-visual event perception (AVEP) determines which events occur in a video, when they occur, and whether they are audible, visible, or both. Training-free methods query new event vocabularies by matching frozen audio and visual features with text-encoded event names. However, related labels share evidence. An incorrect label can then score at least as high as a correct one. We call this a false co-activation (FCA). No scalar cutoff can reject the incorrect label while keeping every correct one. Class-specific thresholds may prevent that label from becoming a final prediction, but the FCA remains in the underlying score vector. We introduce SCoPE, a training-free framework in which all queried labels compete for shared evidence and each modality guides event selection in the other. We derive an exact condition for when this competition removes an FCA in a two-label fit. With identical frozen CLIP+CLAP backbones on LLP, SCoPE improves Type@seg by 7.45 points and Event@seg by 5.04 points compared with the reported AV$^2$A values. The same fixed configuration transfers unchanged to OV-AVEBench and VGGSound-AVEL100k.

</details>


### [55] [SportsGrounder: Proposal-Aided Interleaved Grounding for Dense Sports Video Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07932)
*Yizhi Li,Jiawei Jiang,Guanhong Wang,Yingcai Wu,Gaoang Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出SportsGrounder框架，通过开放词汇视觉专家辅助交错式接地（interleaved grounding）来提升密集体育视频的细粒度推理能力，在SoccerNet和FineSports衍生的新密集体育VQA数据集上达到最先进水平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前大型多模态模型（LMMs）在处理密集体育视频推理时面临根本性挑战：这类视频包含大量小尺度、高度交互且视觉同质化的实体（如穿着相同队服的球员、球），需要跨长时间上下文的细粒度理解。由于缺乏细粒度视觉细节，现有模型过度依赖文本先验来猜测答案，尤其在区分视觉上相似的动作和球员时表现不佳。

Method: 提出SportsGrounder框架，核心包含三个模块：(1) 利用开放词汇视觉专家提取领域引导的目标提议，实现精确空间定位；(2) 引入交错接地融合（IGF）机制，逐帧整合显式边界框坐标和隐式视觉语义与全局网格特征，保持严格时间对齐并防止序列长度爆炸；(3) 设计动作感知监督（AAS）模块，直接规范化模型隐藏状态，强制网络学习准确运动表征而非依赖语言偏差。最后采用混合偏好优化（MPO）来更好地区分欺骗性干扰项。

Result: 在新构建的密集体育VQA数据集（源自SoccerNet和FineSports）上的广泛实验表明，SportsGrounder显著提升了细粒度推理能力，并在准确率上达到了最先进水平。

Conclusion: SportsGrounder通过交错接地融合与动作感知监督有效解决了密集体育视频中LMMs过度依赖文本先验的问题，验证了显式空间定位与动作表征学习相结合的方法在细粒度视频推理中的有效性。

Abstract: Sports video analysis is crucial for athletic analytics and broadcasting enhancement. Current Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) inherently struggle with such dense visual complexities. Due to the lack of fine-grained visual details, these models often over-rely on textual priors to guess answers, especially when distinguishing visually similar actions and players. To achieve precise spatial localization, we extract domain-guided object proposals and introduce an Interleaved Grounding Fusion (IGF) mechanism. Furthermore, we design an Action-Aware Supervision (AAS) module that directly regularizes the model's hidden states, forcing the network to learn accurate motion representations rather than relying on language bias.   <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: We present FlexSplat, a feed-forward framework for novel view synthesis (NVS) from uncalibrated, object-centric multi-view image collections. An uncertainty-weighted depth-consistency objective lets the jointly trained geometry adapt to the reconstruction task, while the cross-view consensus formed during decoding absorbs the residual error of the estimated cameras and depth. The representation uses a compact Gaussian budget that is decoupled from the input resolution - unlike pixel-aligned methods, the primitive count does not grow with the image grid - and is not dictated by the number of views. On ShapeNet-SRN and Google Scanned Objects (GSO), FlexSplat matches or approaches posed state-of-the-art reconstructors while requiring neither camera poses nor ground-truth depth, and matches the best perceptual (LPIPS) quality among the compared methods on GSO. ### [57] [LAD-COD: Language-Aligned Dense Perception for Camouflaged Object Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07941)
*Shangye Song,Tianzhi Zhu,Syed Ariff Syed Hesham,Xin He,Yun Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: LAD-COD是一种用于伪装物体检测（COD）的语言对齐密集感知框架，通过将自顶向下的语义目标引导与自底向上的分层视觉特征对齐，在CAMO、COD10K和NC4K数据集上的全部12个数据集-指标对比中取得最佳结果。

  <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: Camouflaged object detection (COD) aims to segment objects that exhibit high visual similarity to their surroundings, which reduces foreground-background discriminability and weakens boundary evidence across appearance, texture, and structure. Such limitations motivate the use of instruction-conditioned semantics as top-down guidance for identifying which weak visual cues are relevant to the target. Recent segmentation systems built on large multimodal models (LMMs) demonstrate this possibility through instruction-conditioned target embeddings that guide mask decoding. However, in this language-to-mask paradigm, the generated target embedding conditions mainly the mask decoder, leaving the dense visual features that must preserve low-contrast boundaries and fine local structure without explicit guidance. Instead of fully adapting a large generic image encoder, LAD-COD learns a trainable hierarchical visual branch that captures camouflage-sensitive texture, boundary, and contextual information. To align these features with the target embedding, LAD-COD applies Language-Aligned Dual Visual Fusion (LADVF), which extends the embedding beyond sparse prompting to query patch-level language-aligned features and to gate their residual integration with the hierarchical features. </details>

*Zhennan Chen,Tianxing Shi,Pengcheng Xu,Kepan Nan,Qian Wang,Zili Yi,Jian Yang,Ying Tai*

  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VAR因其next-scale预测范式而广受欢迎，但在处理包含多目标和多属性的复杂场景时面临严重的性能瓶颈。现有基于扩散的增强方法无法有效解决VAR中特有的跨尺度误差传播与累积问题。

Conclusion: SynVAR作为首个专门针对VAR范式的训练免费增强框架，通过空间-语义协同控制策略有效抑制跨尺度误差传播，为提升VAR在复杂场景下的生成性能提供了有效的解决方案。

Abstract: VAR has gained widespread popularity due to its next-scale prediction paradigm. However, it faces substantial performance bottlenecks when handling complex scenes with multiple objects and attributes. Existing diffusion-based enhancement methods fail to adequately address the unique challenge of cross-scale error propagation and accumulation in VAR. To this end, we propose SynVAR, the first training-free enhancement framework specifically tailored for the VAR paradigm, which introduces a spatial-semantic collaborative control strategy to effectively suppress propagation error and improve generation quality. SynVAR comprises three key components: (1) Global guidance to ensure reasonable spatial structure in the early stages, (2) Receptive field constraints to mitigate early-stage semantic confusion, (3) High-frequency compensation to recover fine-grained details. Extensive quantitative and qualitative experiments demonstrate the significant improvements in the ability of SynVAR to enhance the VAR's capability for complex scene modeling.

</details>

  <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: Multimodal industrial anomaly detection has largely focused on discrete products using strongly correlated RGB and 3D observations, leaving continuous process manufacturing and weakly correlated sensing modalities underexplored. We introduce LIBAD, the first multimodal anomaly detection benchmark for Li-ion battery electrode manufacturing. Collected from real roll-to-roll production lines, LIBAD provides aligned double-sided visible-light imaging, high-resolution X-ray radiography, and inline-compatible low-resolution X-ray radiography. Electrode patches in LIBAD exhibit highly homogeneous material appearance, while defect evidence can be strong in one modality but weak or absent in another, resulting in pronounced cross-modal anomaly inconsistency. Benchmarks of representative methods under the inline-compatible visible-light and low-resolution X-ray setting exhibit limited transferability and consistently high false-positive rates. We therefore propose DA-Core, a memory-based method that jointly considers feature-space coverage and local density of normal features during coreset selection, allowing compact memory banks to better preserve fine-grained normal variations. With a coreset ratio of 0.05, DA-Core reduces FPR95 from 60.4% to 54.3% compared with standard farthest point sampling. At this ratio, DA-Core also outperforms the best standard coreset result (obtained at 0.20) while reducing inference time by 43.9%. These results suggest that both the data distribution of normal features and the modality relationship itself require explicit consideration when designing anomaly detection methods for process manufacturing.

</details>


### [60] [Distilling Physical Priors into Streaming World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07981)
*Liangliang Zhao,Junying Wang,Danni Yang,Yifan Chang,Bin Fu,Yu Qiao,Bowen Zhou,Yihao Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出PhyS，一个三阶段的物理先验蒸馏框架，用于流式世界模型。通过构建120K真实物理交互视频数据集PhyS-120K、物理感知监督微调注入物理先验到14B双向DiT教师模型，再蒸馏为1.3B因果DiT流式生成模型，最后用在线强化学习和时间信用路由（TCR）增强物理一致性，在PhysicsIQ等多个基准上大幅超越基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 流式世界模型虽然能在线预测未来视觉状态并保持长时程物理连贯动态，但其生成结果经常违反基本物理约束。现有方案通过将预训练的双向DiT蒸馏为少步因果生成器来尝试解决，但存在两大根本局限：通用双向教师模型从视觉导向预训练中获得的物理先验有限，且这些有限先验在双向到因果的蒸馏过程中进一步损失。

Result: 在PhysicsIQ基准上，PhyS将Wan2.1-14B教师模型提升18.2%，将Self Forcing、Rolling Forcing和Causal Forcing分别提升23.7%、14.8%和31.4%。在物理感知视频基准VideoPhy、VideoPhy2和PhyGenBench上也均取得改进。

Conclusion: PhyS通过物理数据构建、物理感知微调和强化学习驱动的物理一致性优化，有效解决了流式世界模型中物理先验获取不足和蒸馏损失两大核心问题，显著提升了长时程物理惯性的生成质量。

Abstract: Streaming world models predict future visual states online while maintaining physically coherent dynamics over long horizons. However, their rollouts often violate basic physical constraints. A common approach distills pretrained bidirectional DiTs into few-step causal generators. However, this paradigm suffers from two fundamental limitations: generic bidirectional teachers acquire limited physical priors from visually oriented pretraining, and the limited priors suffer further loss during bidirectional-to-causal distillation. We present PhyS, a three-stage framework for distilling physical priors into streaming world models. To acquire physical priors from real-world interactions, we construct PhyS-120K, a dataset of 120K real-world physical-interaction videos spanning rigid-body dynamics, soft-body deformation, fluid phenomena, and phase transitions. Each video is annotated with structured descriptions of object properties and causal state transitions. Physics-aware supervised fine-tuning injects the physical priors into a bidirectional 14B DiT teacher, which we then distill into a lightweight 1.3B causal DiT for few-step autoregressive streaming generation. Finally, we use online reinforcement learning to incentivize the distilled model to generate physically plausible rollouts and further propose Temporal Credit Routing (TCR) to address temporal credit assignment. TCR evaluates physical consistency over overlapping temporal windows and routes the resulting group-relative advantages to temporally aligned denoising actions. On PhysicsIQ, PhyS improves the Wan2.1-14B teacher by 18.2\% and the Self Forcing, Rolling Forcing, and Causal Forcing by 23.7\%, 14.8\%, and 31.4\%, respectively. Results also improve the physics-aware video benchmarks VideoPhy, VideoPhy2, and PhyGenBench. The dataset, code, and more sample videos are available on our Project Page.

</details>


### [61] [AdaDINO: Pair-Aware In-Backbone Adaptation of Frozen DINO for Efficient Remote Sensing Change Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07982)
*Xu Zhang,Xinqing Li,Jianpeng Xie,Zeshuai Zhu,Xin He,Yun Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: AdaDINO是一个面向遥感变化检测的配对感知骨干内部适配框架，通过将冻结的DINO编码器与双时相交互机制结合，在不微调主干网络的条件下实现高效变化检测，在四个基准数据集上取得了具有竞争力的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的视觉基础模型（如DINO）是为单图像表示预训练的，而遥感变化检测需要对双时相图像对进行推理。已有的基于VFM的方法通常独立编码两张图像，仅在后期进行比较，导致VFM主干网络无法感知跨时相的关系，存在严重的语义鸿沟。

Method: 提出AdaDINO框架，包含三个核心组件：(1) Change-aware Gated Local Adaptation (CGLA)模块，在冻结的DINO编码器选定块之后耦合双时相流，注入共享的时间残差（符号相反），增强真实变化响应同时保持图像对中点；(2) Batch-Shared Chunk Selection (BSCS)通过保留批次共享的通道块子集，将其作为紧凑密集FFN执行，减少前馈网络计算量；(3) CGLA-Prior-Guided Refinement (CPGR)解码器复用编码器的变化响应进行从粗到细的预测。

Result: 在四个遥感变化检测基准上的实验表明，AdaDINO在基于VFM的基线中具有竞争力或更优性能，在类别无关的SYSU-CD数据集上增益最大。去除62.5%的FFN隐藏宽度后，AdaDINO在SYSU-CD上仍能达到85.29%的F1分数，同时实现1.41倍的吞吐量加速。

Conclusion: AdaDINO证明了通过在冻结的视觉基础模型骨干内部引入配对感知的双时相交互机制，可以有效弥补VFM预训练范式与变化检测任务之间的不匹配，在保持高效计算的同时实现优异的变化检测性能。

Abstract: Vision foundation models (VFMs) such as DINO are pretrained for single-image representation, whereas remote sensing change detection requires reasoning over a bi-temporal pair. Existing VFM-based methods usually encode the two images independently and compare them only afterward, leaving the VFM backbone unaware of cross-temporal relations. To bridge this mismatch, we present AdaDINO, a pair-aware in-backbone adaptation framework that equips a frozen DINO encoder with bi-temporal interaction for efficient change detection. Its core component, Change-aware Gated Local Adaptation (CGLA), couples the two streams after selected frozen blocks and injects a shared temporal residual into them with opposite signs, enhancing genuine change responses while preserving the pair midpoint. Batch-Shared Chunk Selection (BSCS) further reduces feed-forward network (FFN) computation by retaining a batch-shared subset of channel chunks that can be executed as a compact dense FFN. A CGLA-Prior-Guided Refinement (CPGR) decoder reuses encoder-side change responses for coarse-to-fine prediction. Experiments on four remote sensing change detection benchmarks show that AdaDINO achieves competitive or superior performance against VFM-based baselines, with the largest gain on the category-agnostic SYSU-CD dataset. With 62.5% of the FFN hidden width removed, AdaDINO still achieves an F1 score of 85.29% on SYSU-CD while delivering a 1.41$\times$ throughput speedup. The code will be released.

</details>


### [62] [AgriField-40K: Adapting Vision Models to Agriculture With Efficient Continual Pretraining](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07984)
*Vasileios Tzouras,Paraskevas Pegios,Lazaros Nalpantidis*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 AgriField-40K 数据集（整合17个公开资源、覆盖多种作物/杂草/田间条件的野外农业图像）和 AgriMAE 参数高效持续预训练基线，通过仅训练轻量适配器来适应自然图像上预训练的掩码自编码器，并在多种下游任务中验证迁移效果。AgriMAE 可在参数量减少高达9倍的情况下匹配甚至超越全参微调性能。

Motivation: 农业计算机视觉对精准农业至关重要，但现有方法严重依赖昂贵的标注成本和大型预训练模型的高昂适配开销，缺乏面向农业场景的高效持续预训练方案。

Abstract: Field-based agricultural computer vision is important for precision agriculture, yet it largely depends on expensive annotations and costly adaptation of large pretrained models. We introduce AgriField-40K, a field-centric dataset curated from 17 public resources and covering diverse crops, weeds, and field conditions. We further explore semantic feature reconstruction as an alternative pretraining objective and evaluate transfer across multiple tasks. AgriMAE consistently improves downstream performance and can match or even outperform full fine-tuning while using up to $9\times$ fewer trainable parameters, showing that AgriField-40K is a practical resource for continual pretraining in agricultural vision. *Ling Lin,Yang Bai,Congcong Zhu,Jiangming Shi,Meng Wang,Yang Long,Jingrun Chen,Ling Shao,Huazhu Fu*

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态大语言模型在复杂空间场景理解和推理任务上展现出潜力，但其开放式推理过程容易产生决策错误和错误累积，导致答案质量不稳定。现有方法缺乏对推理过程的动态干预与纠正机制，需要一种能够提供中间监督信号并选择性干预推理路径的框架。

Method: 1) 将逐步推理建模为有限时域决策过程，在推理树上引入蒙特卡洛值评估提供中间监督信号；2) 设计Step-Advantage Gate和Trajectory-Advantage Gate两个门控模块，分别动态选择高价值推理步骤和高品质完整推理轨迹；3) 训练阶段通过多分支采样生成的推理树进行门控的监督学习，采用共享参数初始化结合任务特定头部实现跨任务鲁棒性和多样性；4) 推理阶段贪心选择高价值前缀推理步骤，并根据问题类型选择最优推理头；5) 构建Reasoning-Tree-160k数据集，进行两阶段学习。

Result: 大量实验表明，该优势引导门控框架能有效增强基准MLLM在基于视觉的空间理解和推理任务上的性能，显著提高最终答案的准确性，且代码已开源供研究使用。

Conclusion: 优势引导的门控框架通过动态干预和纠正推理过程中的偏差，有效解决了MLLM开放式推理中错误累积导致答案质量不稳定的问题，为提升多模态空间推理能力提供了一种可行且有效的方法。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have demonstrated significant potential in complex spatial scene understanding and reasoning tasks. However, their open-ended reasoning process is prone to decision errors and error accumulation, leading to instability in answer quality. To address this, we propose an advantage-guided gating framework that dynamically intervenes in and corrects deviations during the reasoning process. Specifically, we model step-by-step reasoning as a finite-horizon decision process and introduce Monte Carlo value evaluation on the reasoning tree to provide intermediate supervision signals. The framework includes Step-Advantage Gate and Trajectory-Advantage Gate, which dynamically select high-value reasoning steps and high-quality complete reasoning trajectories, respectively. During training, we perform supervised learning for the gates using reasoning trees generated via multi-branch sampling, and combine shared-parameter initialization with task-specific heads to achieve cross-task robustness and diversity. During inference, the model greedily selects high-value prefix reasoning steps while choosing the optimal reasoning head based on the problem type, thereby significantly improving the accuracy of the final answer. Furthermore, we constructed the Reasoning-Tree-160k dataset and performed two-stage learning on it. Extensive experiments demonstrate that this advantage-guided gating framework effectively enhances the performance of benchmark MLLMs in visual-based spatial understanding and reasoning tasks. The code is open to the public for research: https://github.com/LingLin-ll/Advantage-Guided-Gate.

</details>

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有运动-文本检索基准存在三大缺陷：室内同质运动占主导、运动分布不均衡、文本描述过于简单且重复，导致无法可靠评估跨域和跨粒度的对齐能力。需要一个更全面、更均衡、多粒度的基准来推动运动-语言对齐评估的发展。

Method: 构建流程上采用多阶段数据策展管道：候选过滤与平衡、无歧义语义对齐验证、多粒度运动贴合描述生成。模型方面提出轻量级粒度感知模型：以冻结的标准描述对齐检索模型为锚点，利用LLM生成的简洁和细粒度描述作为伪监督信号，训练额外的粒度特定运动提取器和文本适配器；推理时通过粒度感知分数融合将全局相似度与适配后的相似度结合，保证各描述粒度间的分数可比性。

Result: 在MRBench上的大量评估显示代表性检索基线存在显著的跨数据集泛化差距以及对查询粒度的明显敏感性。提出的粒度感知模型在混合粒度检索上取得提升，同时不损害标准描述性能。

Conclusion: MRBench为运动-语言对齐评估提供了一个全面的测试平台，揭示了现有方法在跨域和跨粒度场景下的不足，并展示了粒度感知建模在改善多粒度运动-文本检索中的有效性。

Abstract: Human motion-text retrieval provides a rigorous means of assessing cross-modal alignment. Prevailing benchmarks are dominated by homogeneous indoor motions, imbalanced motion distributions, and oversimplified, repetitive texts, which hinder the reliable measurement of cross-domain and cross-granularity alignment. We thus introduce MRBench, a comprehensive motion-text retrieval benchmark featuring heterogeneous motions, broad and balanced category coverage, and reliable, discriminative, multi-granular descriptions. MRBench is constructed through a meticulously designed multi-stage data curation pipeline, which filters and balances candidates, verifies unambiguous semantic alignment, and generates motion-grounded descriptions at multiple granularities. The resulting benchmark contains 3,390 motions drawn from motion capture, in-the-wild videos, synthetic videos, and motion generative models, covering 118 fine-grained categories. Each motion is paired with concise, standard, and fine-grained descriptions, yielding 10,170 captions. Extensive evaluations of representative retrieval baselines on MRBench reveal a substantial cross-dataset generalization gap and pronounced sensitivity to query granularity. We propose a lightweight granularity-aware model anchored at a frozen standard-caption-aligned retrieval model. LLM-based concise and fine-grained captions provide pseudo-supervision for extra-branch granularity-specific motion extractors and text adapters. For inference, granularity-aware score fusion integrates global and adapted similarities while strictly maintaining score comparability across all description levels. The resulting model improves mixed-granularity retrieval without compromising standard-caption performance. We believe that our MRBench provides a comprehensive testbed for advancing motion-language alignment evaluation.

*Kutub Uddin,Nusrat Tasnim,Khalid Malik*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出PE-Mamba，一种基于预训练PE-Core视觉Transformer和轻量级LoRA适配的AI生成图像检测框架。通过三个互补组件（双向选择性聚合器BSA、Softmax加权聚合器SWA和Sigmoid门控融合SGA）实现跨层特征聚合，在UniversalFakeDetect和AIGCDetect数据集上超越18个检测器，仅训练1.3%的总参数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于视觉Transformer的AIGI检测器通常采用加权求和策略聚合跨层中间表示，忽视了分层特征从浅层纹理到深层语义的有序语义递进关系，导致检测性能受限。

Method: 提出PE-Mamba框架：1）双向选择性聚合器（BSA）通过前向/后向选择性扫描分别实现浅到深的取证证据累积和深到浅的上下文精炼；2）软max加权聚合器（SWA）计算所有层令牌的学习全局摘要；3）Sigmoid门控融合（SGA）通过可学习标量门动态平衡BSA和SWA输出。整体基于预训练PE-Core视觉Transformer，采用LoRA轻量级适配。

Result: 在UniversalFakeDetect上达到96.6% mACC和99.5% mAP，在AIGCDetect上达到95.3% mACC和98.1% mAP，超越18个检测器，具有优异的跨生成模型泛化能力，仅训练1.3%总参数（LoRA本身仅0.13%）。

Conclusion: 通过显式建模Transformer各层特征的有序语义演进关系，并融合双向序列聚合与全局加权聚合，PE-Mamba在极低训练参数量下实现了先进的AIGI检测性能和强泛化能力，验证了层级语义递进信息对伪造检测的重要价值。

Abstract: AI-generated image (AIGI) detection has become increasingly challenging due to the rapid advancement of generative models and the diminishing gap between synthetic and authentic content. Existing vision transformer-based detectors commonly rely on weighted-sum strategies to aggregate intermediate representations across transformer layers, often overlooking the inherently ordered semantic progression of hierarchical features from shallow texture cues to deep semantic representations. In this work, we propose \textbf{PE-Mamba}, a novel framework built upon a pre-trained PE-Core vision transformer with lightweight LoRA adaptation that introduces three complementary components for cross-layer feature aggregation and fusion. First, a bidirectional selective aggregator (BSA) processes layer-wise classification tokens through forward and backward selective scans, where the forward scan progressively accumulates shallow-to-deep forensic evidence, and the backward scan performs deep-to-shallow contextual refinement to reinterpret low-level cues in light of high-level semantic context. Second, a softmax-weighted aggregator (SWA) computes a learned global summary of all layer tokens as a complementary aggregation path. Third, a sigmoid-gated blend (SGA) adaptively fuses the BSA and SWA outputs via a learnable scalar gate, allowing the model to dynamically balance directional sequential evidence and global layer-wise aggregation. Extensive experiments on UniversalFakeDetect (96.6\% mACC, 99.5\% mAP) and AIGCDetect (95.3\% mACC, 98.1\% mAP) demonstrate that \methodname{} outperforms 18 detectors with superior generalization across diverse generative models, while training only 1.3\% of total parameters (0.13\% for LoRA alone).

</details>


### [66] [Evidence-Grounded Forensic Reasoning for Detecting and Grounding Multi-Modal Media Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08009)
*Yichun Yeh,Yiheng Li,Xiaobo Hu,Zhen Lei,Yang Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出EFR框架，通过Anchor-and-Verify推理链和可验证奖励系统，实现多模态深度伪造检测的可解释推理，使结论与证据位置显式绑定，达到SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有虚假新闻检测方法（DGM4）多为黑箱，缺乏决策依据；直接应用多模态大语言模型（MLLM）存在两大问题：一是生成的解释与预测证据位置脱节，产生未经验证的归因；二是强制证据-结论一致性需要主动优化，但统一训练信号无法区分局部化token与分类token，导致多头部联合训练不可靠。

Method: 提出Evidence-Grounded Forensic Reasoning（EFR）框架，包含三个核心组件：1）Anchor-and-Verify推理链：先进行模态隔离感知再跨模态比较，以结论坐标为显式锚点，要求下游证据在空间上与之对应；2）可验证奖励系统：在训练阶段强制证据-结论一致性；3）Modality-Decoupled Advantage（MDA）路由机制：缓解跨预测任务中的信用分配错误问题。

Result: 实验表明EFR在DGM4任务上达到SOTA性能，同时能生成结构化的取证推理记录，显式地将解释与证据绑定。

Conclusion: EFR成功解决了MLLM在DGM4任务中解释与证据脱节以及多头部联合训练不可靠的问题，在保持高性能的同时提供了可验证、可追溯的取证推理链路。

Abstract: Fake news increasingly relies on cross-modal image-text forgeries, making transparent and verifiable reasoning chains an urgent need for Detecting and Grounding Multi-Modal Media Manipulation (DGM4). Existing methods produce black-box detection results without any decision rationale, limiting their reliability in forensic practice. Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs) offer a natural path toward explainability, but applying them to DGM4 raises two difficulties. First, models tend to generate explanations disconnected from predicted evidence locations, producing unverified attribution. Second, enforcing evidence-conclusion consistency requires active optimization, yet uniform training signals fail to distinguish localization tokens from classification tokens, making multi-head joint training unreliable. We propose a multi-modal manipulation detector based on an Evidence-Grounded Forensic Reasoning (EFR) framework. EFR introduces an Anchor-and-Verify reasoning chain that enforces modality-isolated perception before cross-modal comparison, with conclusion coordinates as explicit anchors to which downstream evidence must spatially correspond. A verifiable reward system then enforces evidence-conclusion consistency during training, while a Modality-Decoupled Advantage (MDA) routing mechanism mitigats credit misassignment across prediction tasks. Experiments show that EFR achieves state-of-the-art performance while producing structured forensic reasoning records that explicitly bind explanations to evidence.

</details>

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出EgoTrack3D，一个从第一人称RGB视频中直接重建和维护动态3D场景表示的模块化框架，通过将2D分割掩码提升至全局3D坐标系，结合基于点的运动评分机制和基于体素的合并启发式来关联目标轨迹，在ADT数据集上相比最强基线实现了11%的PCL提升，并支持静态和动态物体的持久3D跟踪。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从第一人称视频理解3D场景对机器人和自主导航至关重要，但快速视角变化和部分遮挡使得构建结构化表示具有挑战性。现有3D跟踪和场景图构建方法主要处理显式交互或假设静态场景，无法捕捉复杂动态。

Method: EgoTrack3D采用模块化设计：(1) 将2D分割掩码提升到全局3D坐标系；(2) 使用基于点的运动评分机制；(3) 结合基于体素的合并启发式进行目标关联；(4) 在退化条件下将密集深度图替换为稀疏3D边界框估计，并集成交互引导的动态关联。

Result: 在Aria Digital Twin (ADT)数据集上，EgoTrack3D相比最强基线实现了11%的PCL（正确位置百分比）改进，能够同时跟踪静态和动态物体。在替换为稀疏3D边界框估计的退化条件下仍能保持准确的空间表示。

Conclusion: EgoTrack3D解决了第一人称视频中动态3D场景持久跟踪这一更具挑战性的通用问题，并在噪声观测条件下展现出鲁棒性，适用于实际部署场景。

Abstract: Understanding 3D scenes from egocentric video is fundamental for robotics and autonomous navigation, yet rapid viewpoint changes and partial occlusions make building structured representations challenging. Existing 3D tracking and scene graph construction methods primarily address explicit interactions or assume static scenes, limiting their ability to capture complex dynamics. We introduce EgoTrack3D, a modular framework that reconstructs and maintains a dynamic 3D scene representation directly from egocentric RGB video. The framework lifts 2D segmentation masks into a global 3D coordinate frame, using a point-based motion scoring mechanism alongside a voxel-based merging heuristic to associate object tracks. EgoTrack3D maintains accurate representations over time, achieving an 11% improvement in percentage of correct locations (PCL) relative to the strongest baseline on the Aria Digital Twin (ADT) dataset, while addressing the more general setting of persistent 3D tracking for both static and dynamic objects. Furthermore, to demonstrate the system's robustness under degraded conditions that simulate real-world deployment constraints, we replace dense depth maps with sparse 3D bounding box estimation and integrate interaction-guided dynamic association, enabling EgoTrack3D to maintain accurate spatial representations despite noisy observations.

</details>


### [68] [Evidence-RL: Towards Evidence-intensive Visual Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08021)
*Haojie Huang,Xinlei Yu,Chengming Xu,Zhangquan Chen,Cheng Yang,Qingdong He,Yu Yang,Jiangning Zhang,Xiaobin Hu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出反事实证据解耦（CED）训练时审计方法，通过中性化物体级证据区域并对比支持度下降，与答案正确性结合到GRPO奖励中，鼓励VLM基于局部图像证据而非语言先验或捷径回答。在9个基准、4个骨干网络上超越现有RL后训练方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的感知感知后训练方法通过全局扰动或注意力代理鼓励模型使用图像，但无法验证采样答案是否因果依赖于支撑它的局部证据，导致模型可能依赖语言先验、数据集捷径或不相关内容作答。

Method: 提出CED方法：1）对每个回答中性化一个物体中心证据区域，并将其支持度下降与匹配的非证据区域进行对比；2）将该信号与答案正确性结合到GRPO中，奖励那些依赖证据路径而非捷径或噪音路径的正确答案；3）仅需弱物体级提议，无需问题特定证据标注，且推理时无额外开销。

Result: 在九个公开基准和四个骨干网络上，CED优于现有的基于RL的后训练方法；通过靶向分析验证了其物体中心信号的有效性。

Conclusion: CED通过训练时的反事实证据审计，有效提升了VLM的证据接地能力，在不增加推理成本且无需细粒度标注的前提下，实现了更强的grounding性能。

Abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) should answer from concrete image evidence rather than language priors, dataset shortcuts, or irrelevant visual context. Existing perception-aware post-training methods encourage image use through global perturbations or attention proxies, but they do not test whether a sampled answer causally depends on the local evidence that supports it. We propose Counterfactual Evidence Disentanglement (CED), a training-time evidence audit for VLM grounding. For each response, CED neutralizes an object-centric Evidence Region and compares the resulting support drop against matched non-evidence Regions. We combine this signal with answer correctness inside GRPO, rewarding correct answers that rely on the evidence path rather than shortcut or nuisance paths. CED uses weak object-level proposals, requires no question-specific evidence annotations, and adds no inference-time overhead. Across nine public benchmarks and four backbones, CED outperforms prior RL-based post-training methods, with targeted analyses verifying its object-centric signal.

</details>


### [69] [ZOMP: Zeroth-Order Multi-Modal Prompt Tuning for Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08060)
*Sajjad Ghiasvand,Yifan Yang,Mahnoosh Alizadeh,Ramtin Pedarsani*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出ZOMP，一种完全前向传播的零阶多模态提示调优方法，通过同时扰动随机逼近在冻结的CLIP模型视觉和文本分支中调优深层提示，结合跨模态低秩重参数化、梯度校正动量和预算索引秩调度，在5,000次查询预算下优于现有无反向传播方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 微调CLIP等视觉-语言模型通常需要经过整个模型的反向传播，但在内存受限的边缘设备和专有模型部署中只允许前向传播访问。现有的零阶提示调优方法要么在单一模态中调优提示，要么搜索空间过大导致需要数千次前向传播才能收敛，在实际查询预算下不切实际。

Method: ZOMP由三个关键组件构成：(1) 跨模态低秩重参数化，通过共享因子将视觉和文本两个分支绑定在一起，保持有效搜索维度较小；(2) 梯度校正动量项，稳定噪声零阶梯度估计；(3) 预算索引秩调度，随查询预算消耗逐步解锁模型容量。优化算法采用同时扰动随机逼近（SPSA）。

Result: 在13个视觉-语言基准测试上，匹配5,000次查询预算的条件下，ZOMP在少样本准确率和查询效率两方面一致优于先前的无反向传播提示调优方法，并在base-to-new、跨数据集迁移和分布外设置中表现出更好的泛化能力。

Conclusion: 联合利用多模态性和低秩结构是实现实用、查询高效的无反向传播提示调优的有效途径。

Abstract: Fine-tuning vision-language models such as CLIP typically requires backpropagation (BP) through the full model, which is infeasible when only forward-pass access is available, as is common for memory-constrained edge devices and proprietary model deployments. Prior BP-free, zeroth-order prompt-tuning methods avoid this requirement but often tune prompts in a single modality or optimize over a search space large enough that convergence requires thousands of forward passes, which is impractical under realistic query budgets. We propose ZOMP (Zeroth-Order Multimodal Prompt tuning), a query-efficient, fully forward-only method that tunes deep prompts in both the vision and text branches of a frozen CLIP model using simultaneous perturbation stochastic approximation. ZOMP combines three ingredients: a cross-modal low-rank reparameterization that ties the two branches through a shared factor and keeps the effective search dimensionality small, a gradient-correction momentum term that stabilizes the noisy zeroth-order estimate, and a budget-indexed rank schedule that unlocks capacity as the query budget is spent. Across 13 vision-language benchmarks under a matched 5,000-query budget, ZOMP consistently outperforms prior BP-free prompt-tuning methods in both few-shot accuracy and query efficiency, and it generalizes better across base-to-new, cross-dataset transfer, and out-of-distribution settings. Our results show that jointly exploiting multimodality and low-rank structure is an effective route to practical, query-efficient BP-free prompt tuning.

</details>


### [70] [EvBS: Event-guided Blur Synthesis for Domain-adaptive Motion Deblurring](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08066)
*Junsik Jung,Seokryun Choi,Yoonki Cho,Woo Jae Kim,Andrew Jeong,Sung-Eui Yoon*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: EvBS是一个基于事件相机的事件引导模糊合成框架，通过解耦运动与视觉内容，合成多样化的训练对来校准预训练去模糊模型至目标域，从而提升其在真实世界场景下的域自适应去模糊性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预训练的去模糊模型在真实场景中常因训练与测试分布之间的域偏移（domain shift）而出现性能退化。现有方法受限于运动与视觉内容之间固有的耦合关系，难以有效生成多样化的训练数据来适配目标域。

Method: EvBS利用事件相机的高时间分辨率有效解耦运动与视觉内容，包含两个互补策略：(1) 内在模糊合成（Intrinsic-Blur Synthesis），用内容自身的运动模式模糊清晰图像；(2) 外在模糊合成（Extrinsic-Blur Synthesis），将模糊斑块的运动传递到不同的清晰内容上。通过这两种策略生成多样化的训练对，打破运动与内容自然耦合的约束，并通过微调实现域自适应。

Result: 在多个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，EvBS能有效增强现有去模糊模型在未见测试数据集上的鲁棒性，显著提升了域自适应去模糊性能。

Conclusion: EvBS通过事件相机解耦运动与内容，结合内在与外在模糊合成策略生成多样化训练数据，为预训练去模糊模型的领域自适应提供了一种有效且通用的解决方案。

Abstract: Motion deblurring has achieved remarkable progress with deep learning, yet pre-trained deblurring models often suffer from performance degradation in real-world scenarios due to the domain shift between training and testing distributions. To remedy this, we propose EvBS, an event-guided blur synthesis framework that generates diverse training pairs for calibrating pre-trained models to the target domain. While existing methods are constrained by the inherent entanglement between motion and visual content, our method leverages the high temporal resolution of event cameras to effectively decouple them. This enables us to utilize not only the intrinsic motion that is inherent to the given content but also extrinsic motion transferred from different sources within the target domain, thereby facilitating effective adaptation via fine-tuning. Specifically, EvBS comprises two complementary strategies: Intrinsic-Blur Synthesis, which blurs sharp contents with their own motion patterns, and Extrinsic-Blur Synthesis, which transfers motion from blurry patches to distinct sharp content. This approach generates a diverse set of training pairs that break the inherent constraints of naturally coupled motion and content, resulting in enhanced domain-adaptive deblurring performance. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate that EvBS effectively enhances the robustness of existing deblurring models on unseen testing datasets.

</details>


### [71] [NeuroGuard: Neural Gradient Update Aware of Representation Damage](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08068)
*Taigo Sakai,Kazuhito Hotta*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: NeuroGuard是一种针对长尾类别增量学习（LT-CIL）的更新控制方法，通过自适应梯度缩放（AGS）、置信度排序知识蒸馏重加权（CRK）和脆弱性混合熵门控（FBE）三个组件，在不增加可学习参数的前提下，在任务边界处智能调节特征表示的更新强度，从而在五个LT-CIL设置中全面超越基线方法DGR。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的长尾类别增量学习方法主要关注重放策略、分类器设计或损失函数的改进，但忽略了特征表示在每个任务边界处应如何更新这一关键因素。过度更新特征表示会导致灾难性遗忘，而更新不足则难以有效学习新类别，因此需要一种自适应控制特征表示更新强度的方法。

Method: NeuroGuard包含三个核心组件：(1) 自适应梯度缩放（AGS）将教师模型的不确定性转换为任务级别的梯度缩放系数；(2) 置信度排序知识蒸馏重加权（CRK）为教师预测置信度较低的重放样本分配更大的知识蒸馏权重；(3) 脆弱性混合熵门控（FBE）将旧记忆泄漏信息纳入缩放决策。该方法直接叠加在重放类LT-CIL基线DGR之上，不改变其重放记忆、分类器和损失函数集合，也不引入额外可学习参数。

Result: 在五个LT-CIL设置中，NeuroGuard在所有设置中均优于DGR基线；在四个主要基准对比中取得最佳的任务无关准确率；新旧类准确率均有提升，中等频率类别准确率在全部五个设置中一致提升。受控对比表明，AGS优于匹配的固定缩放控制，证明边界特定的缩放比全局统一缩放更有效。

Conclusion: NeuroGuard证明了任务边界处的特征表示更新强度控制是LT-CIL中一个被忽视但有效的研究维度。其增益并非来自通用的梯度抑制，而是来自边界特定的自适应缩放策略，为长尾增量学习提供了新的改进方向。

Abstract: Long-tailed class-incremental learning (LT-CIL) must learn new classes from imbalanced streams while retaining old classes. Existing methods mainly change replay, classifiers, or losses. We study a different factor, namely how strongly the feature representation should be updated at each task boundary. We propose NeuroGuard, an update-control method added to DGR, a replay-based LT-CIL baseline, without adding learnable parameters. NeuroGuard preserves DGR's replay memory, classifier, and set of loss terms. Adaptive Gradient Scaling (AGS) converts teacher uncertainty into one task-wise gradient scale. Confidence-Ranked Knowledge Distillation Reweighting (CRK) gives larger knowledge-distillation weights to replay samples that the teacher predicts less decisively. Fragility-Blended Entropy Gate (FBE) adds old-memory leakage to the scale decision. Across five LT-CIL settings, NeuroGuard improves over DGR in every setting. In the four main benchmark comparisons, it achieves the best task-agnostic accuracy among the compared methods. The gains extend to both old- and new-class accuracy, while medium-frequency accuracy improves consistently across all five settings. Controlled comparisons show that the gain does not come from generic gradient suppression: AGS outperforms a matched fixed-scale control in all five settings, demonstrating that boundary-specific scaling is more effective than applying the same average scale throughout learning.

</details>


### [72] [SCTD 3.0: Sonar Common Target Detection in the Wild - A Large-Scale, Multi-Scene Dataset from Real Marine Surveys](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08106)
*Peng Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了SCTD 3.0，一个大规模真实测量的合成孔径声呐（SAS）数据集，包含超过10,000个高质量真实SAS图像片段，覆盖10类典型目标、多种海底地貌、多观测角度和多频段（240kHz、450kHz等），并建立了分层式精细标注协议和多任务基准，用于野外开放水域中的声呐常见目标检测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 合成孔径声呐（SAS）对水下小目标的大范围检测至关重要，但大规模、高质量的SAS数据集稀缺，现有基准规模小且局限于单一场景，无法复现复杂声散射、多样海底和多种姿态成像等真实检测场景，阻碍了数据驱动的目标识别研究。

Method: SCTD 3.0数据集采集自多频段（240kHz、450kHz等）SAS系统，包含超过10,000个真实图像片段，覆盖10类典型目标类别；建立了严格的分层标注协议，将目标固有物理属性、部署特征和散射现象解耦标注（涵盖材料、几何、内部结构、掩埋状态、阴影完整性、镜面高光、边缘衍射和共振效应），并构建了目标检测、细粒度分类和属性预测的多任务基准。

Result: 数据集支持跨域、跨场景、跨频率和跨视角泛化评估下的主流深度学习模型评测，为开放水域鲁棒水下目标感知提供了关键数据基石。

Conclusion: SCTD 3.0填补了野外自然水域中大规模真实SAS数据集缺失的空白，能够更好地复现真实检测中的复杂声散射和多样化成像条件，为数据驱动的水下目标感知研究提供了基础性数据资源。

Abstract: Synthetic Aperture Sonar (SAS) is core for wide-area detection of small underwater targets. However, large-scale, high-quality SAS datasets are scarce, hindering data-driven recognition. Existing benchmarks are small and limited to single scenarios, failing to reproduce complex acoustic scattering, diverse seabeds, and multi-pose imaging in real detection. To fill this gap, we introduce SCTD 3.0 - a large-scale real-measured dataset for Sonar Common Target Detection in the Wild in natural waters. It contains over 10,000 high-quality real SAS image snippets from multi-frequency systems (240 kHz, 450 kHz, and others), covering ten typical target categories across varied seabed geomorphologies, with multiple observation angles, detection ranges, and frequency bands. We establish a rigorous hierarchical annotation protocol that decouples labeling of intrinsic physical properties, deployment characteristics, and scattering phenomena - covering material, geometry, internal structure, burial state, shadow integrity, specular highlights, edge diffraction, and resonance effects. This enables fine-grained target characterization. We also construct a multi-task benchmark for object detection, fine-grained classification, and attribute prediction, evaluating mainstream deep learning models under cross-domain, cross-scene, cross-frequency, and cross-view generalization. SCTD 3.0 is expected to provide a critical data cornerstone for robust underwater target perception in open-water environments. SCTD 3.0 is available at https://github.com/automlresearch/SCTD-3.0.

</details>


### [73] [SUMI: Scalable Unified Model for 3D Point Cloud Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.08115)
*Yanlong LI,Kanchana Thilakarathna*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出SUMI，一个扩散增强的细化模块，用于粗到细的点云补全任务。与传统将扩散作为独立点生成器的方案不同，SUMI将带噪声的几何特征与粗结构特征进行交叉注意力融合，在保持全局一致性的同时细化局部几何。该模块可灵活集成到现有粗到细模型中，在PCN、ShapeNet-55/34和MVP基准上均取得一致的改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有粗到细点云补全方法虽然改进了全局结构恢复，但细化阶段往往受限于简单的上采样操作，且与粗结构特征的交互不足，导致局部细节重建困难。此前基于扩散的补全方法将扩散用作独立的点生成器，未能充分利用粗阶段的结构先验信息。

Method: 提出SUMI（扩散增强的细化模块）。其核心设计是：将带噪声的几何特征注入到与粗结构特征的交叉注意力中，利用逆向去噪过程在保持全局一致性的同时细化局部几何。该模块以可插拔方式集成到已有粗到细模型中，作为灵活的细化阶段替代方案。

Result: 在PCN数据集上取得最佳整体CD（Chamfer Distance）和F1-score；在ShapeNet-55上CD降低最高达16.1%；在MVP数据集上所有输出密度下均取得最佳CD。相比强基线方法在三个基准上均有一致改进。

Conclusion: SUMI通过将扩散机制与粗到细补全框架有机结合，有效克服了传统细化阶段的信息瓶颈，验证了扩散增强细化模块在点云补全任务中的有效性，且具有良好的通用性和可集成性。

Abstract: Point cloud completion commonly follows a coarse-to-fine paradigm, where a low-density coarse shape is first predicted and then upsampled to the target resolution.
